class.name: MeshDistanceField
class.brief_description: A per-mesh signed distance field generated at import time.
class.description: Generated for an [ArrayMesh] during scene import when distance field generation is enabled (see [member ProjectSettings.rendering/global_illumination/mesh_sdf/generate] and the [code]meshes/generate_distance_fields[/code] import option). Distances are stored as sparse 8×8×8 bricks of 8-bit values near the surface, with 3 mip levels and one page table per mip. Page table entries are a brick index, or negative sentinels for bricks that are uniformly inside or outside. Brick values are normalized by the mip's band ([member mip_bands]). The field is consumed by NextGI's software ray tracing tier. Mutating the owning mesh's surfaces detaches it.

method.name: get_brick_count
method.description: Returns the number of allocated 8×8×8 bricks at the given mip level.

method.name: get_data_size
method.description: Returns the total size of the stored page tables and brick data, in bytes.

method.name: get_mip_count
method.description: Returns the number of mip levels (3 for imported fields).

method.name: get_voxel_distance
method.description: Returns the signed distance stored at the given voxel of the given mip level, in meters. Voxels in unallocated bricks return the mip band with the brick's sign.

method.name: is_two_sided
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the field was generated from double-sided surfaces and is therefore unsigned.

method.name: sample_distance
method.description: Returns the trilinearly interpolated signed distance at [param position] in mesh-local space, in meters. Negative values are inside the mesh.

members.member: The bounds of the mip 0 voxel grid in mesh-local space.
R8 brick payloads, one [PackedByteArray] per mip level. Each brick holds 512 values in x-major order.
The stored format version. Currently always [code]1[/code].
The normalization band of each mip level, in meters. Stored values span the range [code]-band[/code] to [code]band[/code].
The brick grid dimensions of each mip level, as groups of 3 integers (x, y, z).
The voxel dimensions of each mip level, as groups of 3 integers (x, y, z).
One page table per mip level, with one entry per brick slot: a brick index, [code]-1[/code] for uniformly outside bricks and [code]-2[/code] for uniformly inside bricks.
The size of a mip 0 voxel, in meters.

constants.constant: The source surfaces are rendered double-sided, so the field has no defined interior.
All stored distances are unsigned (a shell around the surface). Set together with [constant FLAG_TWO_SIDED].
